rows.notes: The paper is a conceptual system proposal (block, component, use-case and flow diagrams) for an IoT/ML/AR-drone farming system; the 'Results' section is prose summary with no measurements, experiments, survey data or model runs (only a vague mention of 'encouraging feedback from testing phases' without any data). The drone in the proposed design applies fertilizer mapped via AR; pest suppression is only mentioned in passing as a potential benefit of aerial monitoring, never tested. No own evidence on UAV spraying for pest control or on pest suppression efficacy.

notes: Design/concept paper without empirical results; cannot support any evidence-based claim about UAV prescription spraying and pest suppression.
